forge.setup.required: Configure an LLM model here before using Prompt Forge or an AI helper. Your draft has been kept; no generation was started.
forge.setup.environment: Install or open a DEAS environment first, then add a local GGUF model or configure an LLM server.
forge.noModels: No LLM model found: add a GGUF to ComfyUI/models/llm or set a server under Backend → LLM
forge.noBackend: Start the backend of an installed environment to use Prompt Forge.
forge.noDialect: Prompt Forge has no prompt style for this model
forge.outdated: Prompt Forge needs a newer DaSiWa node pack on the backend: Backend → Upgrade.
forge.pick: Pick pictures from the input folder:
forge.detectHelp: Needs a vision model. Detection creates candidates; current boxes change only when you use them. Matching counts retain the existing identities left to right. Cancel discards the result and requests a best-effort stop.
forge.detectInput: Detection needs an installed backend and a picture inside its input folder. Manual boxes still work.
forge.detectCount: Detected {count} people. Review numbering after applying.
forge.detectNone: No people found. Current boxes are unchanged; use manual boxes instead.
forge.detectCancelled: Result discarded; a best-effort backend stop was requested. Current boxes are unchanged.
forge.detectVision: Choose a vision-capable model to find people.
forge.detectBusy: The backend is busy. Retry after the workflow or Forge finishes.
forge.boxHint: Boxes override the people/order selection. Drag a box to move it or its corner to resize; arrow keys work on focused boxes and handles. Sources are unchanged.
forge.boxImageError: Could not load the reference picture for box editing.
forge.peopleHint: Tap character numbers in order. Tap again to remove; at least one stays. Changing the picture label resets this selection.
forge.see: Let the model see the pictures (needs a vision model)
forge.blind: This model cannot see pictures; it wrote from the text only.
forge.stale: This draft was written for other settings (mode, duration, canvas, references or model). Write again to apply it.
forge.cast: Cast & scene cards (optional; Read needs a vision model)
forge.native.noData: Prompt Forge data is missing for this environment (forge-data):
forge.keepPositive: Always in the prompt, exactly as typed (trigger words, artist tags)
forge.keepNegative: Always in the negative, exactly as typed
forge.canon: Character canon from the local table: {list}
forge.briefPlaceholder: Describe what you want, in tags or plain English.
forge.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
forge.emptyBody: Write a brief on the left and press Write. The prompt appears here in the format this model expects.
forge.emptyBusy: Looking up tags and writing the prompt…
forge.length.defaultNote: The model decides, following the detail level.
forge.length.wordsNote: Asked for, not enforced: the model aims for about this many words.
forge.length.tokensNote: Hard cap, roughly {words} words: the answer is cut off there.
forge.refinePlaceholder: Refine: e.g. make the lighting colder
forge.secondPassHelp: Hand the prompt back to the model with the brief and ask it to revise. Slower: roughly another 30-60 seconds.
forge.random.title: Randomizer
forge.random.open: Fill the brief with random ideas, no model involved
forge.random.help: Tick a whole box, or open it and tick the pieces inside. Nothing here goes near the model: it picks, you edit, then you write as normal.
forge.random.chaosHelp: A number on each ticked box: how many of its pieces to use.
forge.random.surpriseHelp: Picks the categories for you. Tick boxes to choose what it draws from; tick nothing and it uses everything except NSFW.
forge.tags.traits: {name}: traits from the local character table
forge.tags.noTraits: {name} is not in the local character table.
forge.refs.noteHint: optional, and it outranks everything else
forge.refs.readback: What the model will take from it
forge.refs.readbackStale: Read-back (out of date: the role, fidelity or note changed)
forge.refs.help: {count} of {max}. The model looks at them under their roles before it writes, so it needs a model that can see. PNG, JPEG or WebP; large pictures are scaled down.
forge.refs.tooMany: At most {max} reference pictures; the rest were not added.
forge.refs.unreadable: That picture could not be read.
forge.refs.busy: Reading the pictures, looking up tags and writing the prompt…
forge.refs.writtenFrom: What the pictures were read as (the prompt was written from this)
